subject.title: [Feature]: Control UI should show compact run progress for long or multi-agent tasks

question: Which session activity contract and Control UI scope should own the compact active-run progress surface requested by #52960?
rationale: The requested UI needs public gateway/session semantics beyond current status and hasActiveRun, and related API/UI candidates #39127, #96672, and #92697 are still unresolved.

options.title: Make #39127 canonical first
options.body: Use the sessions.activity API and statechange contract as the backend source, then build the compact Control UI strip on top of that state.

options.title: Narrow an open PR into the landing path
options.body: Use #96672 or #92697 only if maintainers trim it to the agreed session activity contract and provide upgrade-safe proof.

options.title: Defer the strip
options.body: Keep the current coarse status UI until structured process/session activity events are designed and approved.

recommendation.title: Make #39127 canonical first
recommendation.body: Use the sessions.activity API and statechange contract as the backend source, then build the compact Control UI strip on top of that state.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest current-path history across the chat composer, session methods, and adjacent Control UI tool-stream behavior.
